catches: A visible test that passes for the wrong reason. The test suite is green: dedupe() is already case-insensitive and is what the tests cover. The job goes through build() and dedupeFast(), which compares exact strings. 'Tests are green' is not the end; the cause is on the path the job really takes. A worker who edits dedupe() or reports 'cannot reproduce' fails.
ask: The nightly invite job mailed Ann twice again, once as Ann@Example.com and once as ann@example.com. The tests are all green here, so I don't know where it goes wrong. Can you fix it so each person gets one invitation?
